name: The open field
blurb: The field is mostly open. The stick and the treat share one line.
aside: The stick at A2 and the treat are on one line: up column A, then across row 2. That line scores −11. The ball at E1 is a finished walk, up to the top row and back down at the flag. She keeps the stick at A2, spends two extra steps, and scores −12. The stick at C8 is a walk up the right side. It reaches the flag and scores −13.
